description: This Java class 'YearStatistics' extends 'Statistics' and provides methods to analyze books read in the current year, including finding the least and most liked books and calculating the average rating. It operates on a list of books read this year, which is initialized based on the books' start reading dates and ratings.

classes.name: YearStatistics
classes.description: A class that computes statistics for books read in the current year, including least liked, most liked, and average rating.

methods.name: findReadBooksAddedThisYear
methods.description: Filters books that have a start reading date in the current year and have a rating.

methods.name: findLeastLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the lowest rating read this year, if any.

methods.name: findMostLikedBookThisYear
methods.description: Returns the book with the highest rating read this year, if any.

methods.name: calculateAverageRatingGivenThisYear
methods.description: Calculates the average rating of books read this year.

methods.name: calculateTotalRating
methods.description: Sums up the ratings of books read this year, converting ratings to double values.
